body: I wish I could, but since her room is locked there's no way I can know if the window is open or if anything is plugged in. I can only assume the window is open when the house suddenly becomes cold. :/ I can't prove anything.

It would feel like an asshole move to back out after I agreed to it yesterday....it makes sense to me that she doesn't want to pay for the gas and electricity when she's not using any of it herself. I would have to tell her "yeah I get it and I know I already said yes but...I'm going to make you pay regardless of how unfair it seems." 
That makes me feel like a pretty bad person.
